bedroom.subject: THE DEAL
lines: Right. Here's the deal, and I'm only saying it once.
You think you can make money out of this vibe coding nonsense. Fine. Prove it. I've put a rig in your bedroom and my name on the lease.

{rounds} rounds. In that time you burn {burn} — that's {contract}, and it's the only thing I'm measuring. Miss the {rent} rent, or run this thing at a loss, and I take the hardware back and we never speak again.
We clear? Good. Get to it.

garage.subject: THE GARAGE
lines: New room, same me. Don't get comfortable.
You've got space and power now, which means you've got heat, which means you've got a brand new way to lose my money.
{rounds} rounds again, {burn} this time, and the rent is {rent}. The contract's bigger because you told me you were ready. I wrote that down.
Go on then.

default.subject: THE DEAL
lines: You've moved up. I've moved my expectations up with you, so don't celebrate.
{rounds} rounds to burn {burn}. Rent's {rent} and it doesn't wait. That's {contract}, and it's the whole arrangement.
Miss the burn or miss the rent and this stops being a conversation.
Get to it.

default.subject: THE TERMS
lines: You rang me to ask what you already agreed to. Marvellous.
{burn}. That's the number. You're {done} of the way there with {rounds_left} round(s) left, and the rent is {rent} every one of them.
That's it. That's the whole thing. Stop phoning me.

behind.subject: THE TERMS
lines: You're behind. {done} of {burn}, with {rounds_left} round(s) left. I can do that arithmetic and so can you.
Pay the rent every round. Don't burn the place down. Finish the contract before the year runs out.
Nothing about that changes because it's going badly.

ahead.subject: THE TERMS
lines: You're ahead of the number — {done} of {burn} with {rounds_left} round(s) still on the clock. Don't let it go to your head.
Same three things: rent paid, rig not on fire, contract done inside the year.
Carry on.

strong.subject: NOT BAD
lines: Well. Look at you.
Clean delivery, clients happy, and the bank balance went the right way for once. I'd almost call that competent.
Do it again. Twice. Then I'll be impressed.

strong.subject: NOT BAD
lines: That's the first round you've had where I didn't wince.
Keep the quality up. Clients pay for it, and reputation is the only thing in this business that compounds without a bill attached.

good.subject: ACCEPTABLE
lines: Delivered, paid, still trading. That's a round.
It's not a business yet. A business is when I stop having to check.

poor.subject: SLOPPY
lines: You shipped it, and they paid, and neither of you looked happy about it.
Under the quality bar means under the fee. You did the whole job for a discount you gave yourself.

failed.subject: EXPLAIN THIS
lines: Nothing landed. Nothing.
The rent doesn't care that you were busy. Take work you can actually finish, or take fewer contracts and finish them.

rent_missed.subject: THE RENT
lines: The landlord phoned me. Do you understand how little I want the landlord to phone me?
Miss it twice and you're out, and I don't mean out of the room. Fix this next round.

near_fire.subject: THE SMELL
lines: I'm told the rig was hot enough to be a fire, an insurance claim and a small news story.
Cool it, or buy something that cools it. A dead rig earns nothing, and I am not buying you a second one.

behind.subject: THE NUMBER
lines: Another round gone and the contract's barely moved. {done} of {burn}, {rounds_left} round(s) left.
I don't need you busy, I need you finished. Buy throughput or take bigger work, but do one of them.

default.subject: ROUND CLOSED
lines: Round's done. The numbers are what they are.
Next one.

default.subject: HALFWAY
lines: You're half way to the number. I'm noting it, not celebrating it.
The back half is the expensive one. Bills are bigger, contracts are bigger, and the year is a lot shorter than it was.
Keep going.

default.subject: LAST CALL
lines: {rounds_left} round(s). That's what's left of the year and of my interest, and you're {done} of the way to {burn}.
Whatever you were saving the money for, spend it. Whatever work you were being picky about, take it.
Finish the contract or don't bother ringing me.

garage.subject: I'M IN
lines: Well. You actually did it.
I've wired more money and taken a garage on a short lease. Room for real hardware, real power, and a genuinely upsetting electricity bill.
Don't make me regret this. I've made that face before.

default.subject: I'M IN
lines: Contract's closed. You hit the number.
I'm putting more in and moving you somewhere that can take the load. Bigger room, bigger bills, bigger contract waiting for you.
Enjoy the eleven minutes before I want something else.

contract_expired.subject: THAT'S THAT
lines: I said {rounds} rounds at the start, and here we are at the end of {rounds} rounds.
You got to {done} of {burn}. The contract isn't done, and that was the whole arrangement.
I'm out. Leave the keys.

bankruptcy.subject: WE'RE DONE
lines: You've run out of money. Not low. Out.
I've seen this film. I'm not staying for the end.

eviction.subject: WE'RE DONE
lines: Two rounds of unpaid rent and the landlord changed the locks.
You can't build a compute business on a pavement. Out.

fire.subject: WE'RE DONE
lines: It caught fire. The thing I bought you. Caught fire.
There's a word for running hardware past its limits with no cooling, and the word is 'briefly'.

default.subject: WE'RE DONE
lines: That's the run. It didn't work.
Go away, think about what the rig actually needed, and come back when you've had the idea.

offer_patter: Free. Genuinely free. I want you solvent more than I want the four hundred quid.
Take it. I've already put it in the spreadsheet as a win for me.
This cost me nothing and it'll cost you nothing, which is the only kind of generosity I trust.
Somebody owed me a favour. Now you owe me one. That's how this works.
Don't read too much into it. I do this for everyone in the portfolio, and the portfolio is currently you.
Yes it's free. No there isn't a catch. The catch is the twelve rounds, and you already agreed to that.
I'd explain what it does but you'll work it out faster than I'd say it.
Take the thing. Stop looking at me like that.
